demo_chips: What does the Lifetime Warranty cover?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Dynamic Home Repair at 1-800-674-2604 or info@dynamichomerepair.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.a: Dynamic Home Repair is a product and service administration company for the manufactured housing industry. It provides warranty product administration and after-sale services to homeowners through dealers and manufacturers, and it started operations in 2019.
When a dealership offers the Lifetime Warranty, no other dealership within 50 miles of its location can offer the same Lifetime Warranty - it's theirs alone.
Yes. The Lifetime Warranty and Dynamic Service are separate programs - you can sign up for one or both, depending on your needs.
faqs.q: Can I sign up for just one program?
